column3: The 1010 Pacific Subordination Agreement provides that upon a casualty to the Mortgaged Property where the repair or reconstruction cost is less than or equal to 35% of the replacement value of the building on the Mortgaged Property, the HPD will determine how insurance proceeds will be applied, which it is required to do within 60 days after it is notified of the casualty.
